pretreatment: degreasing the wafers in acetone, methanol, and isopropyl alcohol for 1 min each, followed by a 3 min etch in 29% NH4OH
evidence: The samples used in this work were n-type Si-doped GaAs wafers with doping concentration of 5 /H110031017 cm−3. Two alternative GaAs starting surfaces were used in this study. The first were native oxides on GaAs that were taken directly out of the sealed wafer holders sent by the GaAs wafer supplier. The other GaAs surfaces were prepared by degreasing the wafers in acetone, methanol, and isopropyl alcohol for 1 min each, followed by a 3 min etch in 29% NH4OH.
